    "9608c793: ;\nThis routine is used to edit the status of a patient's appointment in the\nVISTAAppointment System. It contains the main control logic for editing\nthe status field, including input validation, data retrieval, and data\nstorage.\n",
    "23f9a782: Call the DE subroutine to setup data elements and then go to BEGIN label",
    "94c8e5b6: Set up variables for editing: DIE=file global root, DIC=DIE, DP=file #, DL=0 for WordProcessing,DIEL=0 for no LAYGO, DU=null for lookup value, clear DG, DE, DB. Quit if no data node exists.",
    "4c7374d5: If data node exists, get the current value of STATUS field into DE(1)",
    "0d38cba1: Kill %Z",
    "acd5cdb6: Write prompt for editing STATUS field",
    "c07d529d: Return",
    "0e99e195: Call the W subroutine to write prompt, then write out field value Y. If value is longer than 19 characters and not a word-processing field, branch to RW^DIR2",
    "8e20fd1e: If Y is null and field is not word-processing, and is either free-text or key'ed, branch to RW^DIR2",
    "76827070: If Y is not null, write '// '. If not word-processing and this is an IDENTICAL field, set X=null, write msg '(No Editing)' and quit",
    "753274a9: Read new value into X up to DTIME seconds. Set DTOUT=1 if time runs out, set X='^' on timeout. Write * character on timeout.",
    "7aa0f228: Return",
    "7c2e46ca: Kill DQ array entry to reset and increment DQ",
    "40b77c85: Branch to label corresponding to value in DQ",
    "88f53266: If a previous value exists in DE(DQ), go to PR label. Otherwise, call W to write prompt and TR to read input.",
    "331934b0: 1",
    "496a29ba: 1",
    "3bee9956: 1",
    "e4ac5018: 1",
    "15cae0c1: 1",
    "4e8440f1: 1",

    "4ca4e8e6: 1",
    "ed5e8842: 1",
    "83d0cb3b: 1",
    "db025c40: 1",
    "34157f78: 1",
    "951e00a2: ;Create arrays to hold field information.",
    "730d46cb: ;If DE array is empty, output field label and input transform. Otherwise, re-display existing value and optionally edit.",
    "0202f3aa: ;Look up existing value and parameters for multiple fields.",
    "35ef2d44: ;If field is pointing to a file, find value of .01 field.",
    "7d4c17db: ;For fields pointing to a file, follow the additional @-traversals to get the correct .01 value.",
    "5fa025ad: ;Extract the external value from set of codes.",
    "a1f7febb: ;If existing value, output and allow editing, unless read-only or developer-disabled.",
    "0f90d404: ;If field requires input validation, branch to input validation code.",
    "1d100bed: ;Execute input validation and re-display field unless input passed validation.",
    "51b49a77: ;(No additional comment provided)",
    "e3eaba8b: ;Initialize routine control variables.",
    "48209ca6: ;Initialize field attributes for .11 STATUS field.",
    "c34fc97c: ;Construct prefix for getting/storing data from file 393.2.",
    "d22a8f5c: ;Initialize X with value passed from DGJTST.",
    "07ffba25: ;Initialize Y to same value as X.",
    "77b12b3b: ;If new x is null goto next record, else if new x is wordproc go to input transform",
    "d3e4f92d: ;If new x is non-null and not wordproc exit",

    "a5cc250f: ;Kick control to Fileman"
